inlines.text: 이 페이지는 건강·욕구·부상·치료 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다.

소비자 계약(conservation-with-optional-admitted-treatment-contest): burdenAfter=before+new-recovery; recovery<=before+new. Only physiology policy transitions; treatment win is performance evidence, never recovery/death itself.

blocks.text:
REF-HP-FP [public-reference-not-person-allocation] defaultMaxHP=ST; defaultMaxFP=HT
REF-INJURY [public-reference-not-runtime-dispatch] penetration=max(0,basic-DR); injury=penetration==0 ? 0 : max(1,floor(penetration*typeMultiplier))
SEOUL-HEALTH-EFFECTS [proposal-held] null
D02-F1 [후보·승인 전] burdenAfter=burden+newBurden-recovery; transition=transitionPolicy(burdenAfter,capacity,physiology,evidence); no HP-from-attribute formula
D02-F2 [후보·승인 전] unmetNeed=max(0,need-sum(unique actual fulfillment))
D02-F3 [후보·승인 전] mood=clamp(base+sum(unique effect impact*max(0,1-age/lifetime)),lo,hi); each cause/effect settles once

inlines.text: D02의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

items.text: personId — stableId (identity)
currentHP,maxHP — integer|null (HP)
currentFP,maxFP — integer|null (FP)
food,water — quantity|null (explicit resource-specific unitId)
needs,mood — separate state records|null (axis-specific pending dictionary)
eventId,causeId,effectId — stableId (identity)
snapshotRevision,rulesVersion — revision (version)
treatment — provider/place/consent/resource/progress record (progress unit explicitly approved per method)

inlines.text: 자료 소유자는 D02 health and life state; D01 owns approved personal maxima; D04 owns fulfillment/labor; D15 owns attack resolution; D18 owns world time and save boundary, 유지 계약은 —다. 상태 소유 경계는 physiologyRef,burden,capacity,need fulfillments,thought effects,settled cause/effect keys,health revision. 커밋 규칙: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

items.text: 후보 오류: E_POLICY, E_INPUT, E_CONSENT, E_CONSERVATION
기존 평가기 오류: E_INPUT, E_UNKNOWN, E_UNIT, E_STALE, E_DUPLICATE, E_PROPOSAL

어댑터 결합 규칙: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

inlines.text: 제거 대상 차용 산식: REF-HP-FP, REF-INJURY. Remove call/dependency from original operative consumer, not original records/historical references/tests.

items.text: approved supplied numeric tick half-open lifetime only, not world lifecycle owner
pure safe integer margin/outcome and caller-authorized projection, no profile/rating/receipt authority
caller-supplied trusted boolean gates only; no provenance/authentication/world resolver, absent tag unsupported

inlines.text: 현재 범위 한계: Named helper only; no complete authoritative domain state owner/transaction/consumer workbook. 다음 구현 단위는 U-D02-health-cause-settlement(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/health-cause-settlement.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/health-cause-settlement.test.mjs). 인물·세계 수치 승인과 별개로, 이 아치파이는 계약 구조만을 보여준다.

items.text: 건강·치료 사건 — 인물·규칙·스냅샷·원인·효과와 실제 이행·치료 입력. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[0])
영구 신원·저장 경계 — 동일 저장 경계의 원장 개정·규칙을 요구한다. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[1])
생리·안전·권한·동의 — 생존·생리·구금·안전이 욕구·일정보다 우선한다. 실제 장소·전달·자원·예약·동의를 각각 확인한다. 내부 전체 순서는 미정. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[2])
식량·물 실제 이행 — 식량과 물을 별도 단위로 읽고 구매 잔여 요구 전에 실제 배급을 확인한다. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[3])
최초 원인·정산 키 검사 — person/cause/effect 중복을 소비 도메인 전체에서 확인한다. 개인·집계 손실을 중복 정산하지 않는다. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[4])
정확한 전이 정책 승인 — 치료 방법·소모·회복률·임계값과 효과 함수의 정확한 승인이 필요하다. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[5])
승인 전이 후보만 작성 — 신체·욕구·기분은 독립 상태다. 신체→욕구→기분의 세밀한 갱신 전체 순서는 제안이므로 실행하지 않는다. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[6])
읽기 전용 신체 참조 — 다른 소비자가 읽는 신체와 가능성·결과 증거를 분리하고 같은 노동 손실 재적용 금지. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[7])
상태·정산 참조 동시 반영 — D18의 동일 수락 경계에 승인 상태 변화와 원인·효과 참조를 한 번 기록한다. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[7])
미정 생리·치료 전이 보류 — E_PROPOSAL. 방법·율·임계값 미정은 0효과 성공·추정 회복·추정 사망이 아니다. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[4])
오류·중복·충돌 거부 — 불일치 판본·단위·필수 형식·중복 정산·손실 소유 충돌은 무부분반영. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[3])
중단·사망·복원 — 취소·사망·저장 불러오기 사건을 받는다. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[7])
수행 진척·소비 보존 — 수행·소비는 유지. 미사용 예약 해제는 D03/D04. 공급된 사망 뒤 치료·회복 금지. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[7])
정산 참조·중단 진척 복원 — 호환 저장 경계로 복원하며 load를 취소·사망으로 취급하지 않는다. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[7]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[0])
완료 효과 재실행 없음 — 정산 이력과 영구 신원을 유지한다. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[7])
오류·중복·충돌 거부 — 불일치 판본·단위·필수 형식·중복 정산·손실 소유 충돌은 무부분반영. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[3])

"Inspect existence, survival/physiology/cust​ody, permission, actual place/delivery, resources/reservations and consent. Safety/physiology/custod​y precede needs/schedule; their internal total order is not invented."
"Read actual ration fulfillment before remaining purchase demand; retain food and water separately."
"Bind bodily injury/fatigue effects to the original personal cause; check prior settlement across producer domains."
"For any depletion/recovery, consumption, treatment completion or incapacity transition requiring an unapproved method/rate/threshold, return E_PROPOSAL atomically."
"For approved transitions only, update bodily state, then distinct needs, then distinct mood/effect records under their approved functions. This finer update order is a proposal until approved."
"Publish read-only bodily references and separate feasibility/result evidence; never apply a second labor loss for the same cause/effect."
"Commit at the owning consistent boundary with no fabricated RNG draw or world cadence."
"No armor divisor, location or omitted exception claim; upstream attack owns basic damage."
"D22-B and selectionEffect retain exact function/coefficients approval boundary."
"Reference injury arithmetic consumes no RNG. Attack dice belong to D15; recovery randomness and scope are proposals, not implicit draws."
"D18 continuous world boundary; no fixed tick or daily depletion cadence supplied by this task."
"Only REF-INJURY floor and positive-penetration minimum1 are public anchors. No currentHP clamp to zero and no invented HP death/FP exhaustion threshold."
"Only REF-INJURY floor and positive-penetration minimum1 are public anchors. No currentHP clamp to zero and no invented HP death/FP exhaustion threshold."

"Reinspect remaining work; retain stable ID and historical results; do not heal or execute treatment after a supplied death event."
"Restore consistent boundary, including settlement references and interrupted progress; load is not cancel/death and does not rerun completed effects. Unsupported version produces explicit error."
"No partial commit on unknown required input, duplicate event, disputed loss ownership or version conflict. No auto-renumber or silent migration."

"D29-A separates states; D37-A prevents duplicate settlement without supplying effect magnitude."
"Fine update order, exact commit schema/key encoding and clock/RNG recovery scheduling"
"Carrier design is a validator proposal, not approved world algorithm."
"Actual personal maxima/allocation, country payment records and situation/aggregate combat mappings"
"D18/D24/D32 directions do not approve payloads; no character sampling or new records."

"Sealed choices approve directions and authoring methods, not unspecified functions, units, coefficients or actual records. This evidence pack does not manufacture numeric approval or original Basic certification."
"Separate settlement/occupation payment contract and actual fulfillment ledger. Delivery is not a request or reservation."
"Decision-time knowledge, authority and feasibility remain separate from observed later performance. Unknown observation is not failure."
"Normalize input units first; formulas, coefficients and resulting consumer values remain proposals until exactly approved."
"Personal context-adjusted injury result and aggregate loss refer to one loss ledger; aggregate loss cannot apply the same injury again."
"Current/max HP and FP are bodily state; needs, mood and labor effects are separate states linked by cause."
"Public Lite damage/DR/injury structure is a reference calculation. Seoul real-time execution and modifiers are separate; no turn, pause, speed control or order queue introduced."
"Consumers read approved bodily state without writing it; each cause/effect is settled once, not once per producer domain."
"Prior proposal parts and obsolete Basic dependency wording are not adopted."
"Conflicting historical hunger/inspiration/faith​/pain claims are not Seoul numeric rules."
"Separate currentHP/maxHP/currentF​P/maxFP and injury records; an injury does not delete identity."
"Food deficiency and water deficiency are independent; food sufficient does not establish hydration."
"Requested is not performed. Completion requires actual provider, place, resources, consent and applicable method. Interrupted work preserves performed progress and consumed materials."
"Injury changes action conditions; do not transform any injury into universal action prohibition. Exact thresholds and recovery guards remain proposals."
"Cause-linked independent record; no automatic HP-to-mood or ration-to-mood coefficient."
"Decision-time feasibility evidence and later result remain distinct; read only observed fields."
"Death is supplied by the owning lifecycle decision, never inferred from an invented HP threshold. Keep permanent identity and consumed/history records."
"One injury is not two aggregate/person losses"
"One shortage may have distinct effects, but identical cause/effect cannot settle twice"
